name: SCA bearing dataset
description: The dataset contains vibration measurements from a pulp mill collected between 2019 and the end of 2022 that describe different health states of bearings. It comprises 11 different cases each, except case 11, describing a bearing fault before the bearing was changed. Case 11 contains a fault that is not related to the bearing which can be used to test methods' tendency to generate false alarms. Each case contains two files: one with normal data called “train” and one with only a fault or both a fault and normal data depending on fault development time named “test”. The files contain approximately four months of data with one or more measurements per day. The files are in .mat format and include the vibration data, the fault frequency of each bearing, the time for each measurement, the rotating speed of the shaft and the labels.  Each data file contains, apart from the raw data, the time of measurement, the fault frequencies of the bearing, the rotating speed of the shaft and a label. The possible values of the label are -1, which means that the machine is off or that the speed data of the shaft is missing, 0 for normal conditions, 1 for inner ring fault, 2 for ball fault and 3 for outer ring fault. For more information, we refer to the published article. When citing this dataset, please cite both the article and the dataset.
